source_policy: Prefer the direct first-party IDX release page for structured market-level data.
Use a deterministic parser and reconciliation checks before promoting a release into the product.
Use secondary publications only as explicitly labelled sample evidence.
Search agents are discovery-only; never convert search context into a numeric metric.

not_found: No first-party per-ticker or per-group ownership-flow feed suitable for full-universe confirmation was established. A first-party market-level monthly release was found and integrated separately.
calculation_boundary: The official IDX release is parsed only after table/date/total reconciliation; the bounded company sample remains separate. Search summaries and qualitative sidecars remain non-quantitative.
